notes: `upstream` is the base image the extended Dockerfile FROMs — the Isol8 fork (Isol8AI/agent) built from upstream OpenClaw 2026.7.2 (branch off tag v2026.7.2-beta.3 — 7.2 is BETA-ONLY upstream, no stable cut yet) plus the FIVE carried fork patches. Three are re-expressed onto 7.2's rewritten MCP manager (upstream #106359): bundled-MCP shared-runtime-scope (keys the static runtime on (workspaceDir, agentDir, configFingerprint) so sessions reuse one connected runtime — collapses the per-session EFS connect storm), non-blocking tool materialization (peek-then-warm; a cold catalog streams the run on built-ins and warms MCP in the background), and provider-agnostic size-based context pruning (Isol8AI/agent#1). The FOURTH, new in isol8.2, is the native workspace-seed boot hook: `ensureAgentWorkspace` converts an Isol8 sentinel `.openclaw/isol8-setup-seed.json` into native SQLite workspace-setup-state via OpenClaw's own `mergeWorkspaceSetupState`, then deletes the sentinel — so no legacy `workspace-state.json` is ever written and the #1429 "requires migration" brick class is structurally impossible. It is INERT when no sentinel exists (zero behavior change for existing containers), non-throwing (a failure logs and falls through to normal boot), and kill-switched by env `ISOL8_NATIVE_SETUP_SEED=0`. The FIFTH, new in isol8.4 (skips isol8.3, an abandoned OPENCLAW_SQLITE_DIR relocation approach superseded by the nested-mount O6 layout), is the session-store read-failure fix (fork PR #3): `loadGatewaySessionLookupStore` no longer swallows a `session_entries` read error into an empty map — under the 7.2 SQLite lock-contention class a transient throw otherwise resolved every session lookup to "no such session", so `chat.history` returned ok:true with zero messages (byte-identical to a new session — the intermittent "agent forgot everything / start-a-new-conversation over a real transcript" bug) and `chat.send` re-keyed the session, orphaning its transcript. It now throws a typed SessionLookupUnavailableError that chat.history/chat.startup convert to the retryable UNAVAILABLE shape the client history-retry ladder already recovers from; a missing DB stays a non-error (created on first open). The 7.1 compaction aws-sdk-auth cherry-pick (openclaw#103638) was DROPPED — native in beta.3. REQUIRED to build the extended image FROM this fork tag, NOT vanilla ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw: config.py emits mcp.runtimeScope="shared" which only the shared-runtime-scope patch adds to the strict config schema (McpConfigSchema, relocated to zod-schema.root-support.ts in #106359, still `z.strictObject`) — a vanilla 7.2 base crash-loops every MCP owner and (via 7.x's fail-closed startup-migration checkpoint) fails the whole fleet closed. Tag scheme `<upstream-version>-isol8.<n>`. This is a PRIVATE GHCR package, only pulled by the authenticated build-openclaw-image.yml workflow. DEPLOY POSTURE: 7.2 is beta upstream; prod has been on beta by explicit owner acceptance since 2026-07-20. CURRENT PIN (2026-08-14): both envs on `2026.7.2-isol8.4-ce1908b`, built from merge ce1908be. It carries TWO changes vs the prior pin (9b381a8) — this line previously claimed "SKILL-TEXT-ONLY", which was WRONG and cost two debugging cycles (prod incident 2026-08-14: a boot-failure triage ruled the image out on the strength of it, and had to re-open). `git diff 9b381a8..ce1908b -- apps/infra/openclaw/` is the authority and touches FOUR files, including a 21-line Dockerfile change. (1) BOOT PATH: #1707 changed the compile-cache warm pass from `timeout 60 node openclaw.mjs --help` under a 256MB heap cap to `timeout 120 node openclaw.mjs doctor --non-interactive` with no cap, so the baked cache now covers the doctor graph the boot actually walks. This makes boot FASTER, which is not automatically safe: a large-agent-DB tenant reaches its first SQLite write earlier and can lose a lock race the slower build won (7.2 contention class — one 5s busy_timeout, no retry). Exonerated as a deterministic boot-breaker (dev booted it clean at 16:03:33Z 2026-08-14), but it is a boot-timing change, not a no-op. (2) SKILL TEXT: the bundled paperclip skill now documents the `mode` field (add/remove/replace) that upstream Paperclip made REQUIRED on `POST /api/agents/:id/skills/sync` — without it every agent-driven skill assignment 400s, which it did fleet-wide from the v2026.813-isol8.1 Paperclip deploy until this image landed. Both envs pinned together by explicit owner decision (single-tenant fleet). This build is also the first since the image build moved back to the self-hosted box (#1762): six consecutive hosted-runner builds OOM-killed the 7 GB VM at the `doctor` compile-cache bake ("the hosted runner lost communication with the server", no failed step, no logs), which is why the fleet sat on a 2026-08-12 image for two days. HISTORICAL: `dev.tag` and `prod.tag` were both `2026.7.2-isol8.2-5d9330f` — the extended image built from merge 5d9330fe, which vs the prior pin (3587d44) changes ONLY skills/isol8/SKILL.md: PR #1570 replaces the wrong "every connection is an MCP server" model with the three-rail integration model (mcp = tools appear in the tool list; cli = gh/aws/gog used from the shell, NEVER tools — agents must not hunt for github__*/aws__* namespaces; skill = a bundled skill reads the credential), adds per-rail verification guidance (toolset for mcp, `gh auth status`-style shell checks for cli), and corrects the "missing tool = disconnected" diagnosis (a connected MCP server's tools can silently drop out of a session when the server fails to start — check the Integrations tab before declaring it disconnected). Both envs pinned together by explicit owner decision — copy-only text, no runtime code, so rollback to `2026.7.2-isol8.2-3587d44` costs nothing but the corrected guidance. `image`/`tag`/`full` are the LEGACY PUBLIC upstream image (ghcr.io/openclaw/openclaw): container-stack.ts uses `full` as the bootstrap/unknown-env fallback, pulled by per-user ECS tasks that carry NO registry credentials — so it must stay anonymously pullable and must NOT point at the private fork. `tag` also feeds the OPENCLAW_UPSTREAM_VERSION env-var fallback. `extendedImage` + per-env `dev.tag`/`prod.tag` are the ECR-published extended image deployed to dev and prod. PROMOTION IS MANUAL: build-openclaw-image.yml only READS this file and prints "Bump openclaw-version.json#dev.tag to <tag> in a PR to deploy to dev" to its job summary — it never writes the tags. A green image build therefore ships NOTHING to any container until a human lands a PR flipping these fields (an earlier revision of this note wrongly claimed the workflow re-stamps them, which cost a debugging cycle). STORAGE GATE REMOVED (2026-08-04): the per-env `storage` field is gone and the local-sqlite layout is unconditional, so EVERY tag pinned here MUST be built from a commit containing apps/infra/openclaw/local-sqlite/ — i.e. at or after cda209369 (#1581). A tag older than that has no /usr/local/bin/isol8-local-sqlite-boot.sh and its containers exit 1 on the boot guard. Both envs were promoted to 2026.7.2-isol8.2-18f568c in #1603 for exactly this reason — the prior prod pin (5d9330f, built 2026-08-02) predates the boot chain and would have exit-1'd every prod container on the guard.
